items.markdown:
The best time to visit Chiang Mai is during the cool and dry season from **November to February** , featuring pleasant daytime temperatures of 15°C to 28°C, clear skies, and major cultural festivals like [Yi Peng and Loy Krathong](https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/chiang-mai-ttd271/best-time-to-visit-chiang-mai/).[[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/chiang-mai.html)[[2]](https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/chiang-mai-ttd271/best-time-to-visit-chiang-mai/)

Cool and Dry Season (November to February)

- **Weather:** Most pleasant of the year with low humidity, minimal rain, and cool nights down to 12°C–15°C.
- **Highlights:** Ideal for outdoor activities like hiking in [Doi Inthanon National Park](https://www.thainationalparks.com/doi-inthanon-national-park) , exploring the Old City, and seeing November’s Yi Peng lantern festival.
- **Downside:** Peak tourist season brings larger crowds and higher prices for hotels and flights.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/chiang-mai.html) [[1]](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/best-time-to-visit-chiang-mai)[[2]](https://www.excursionmania.com/article/when-not-to-go-to-chiang-mai-blg-6426)

Hot and Burning Season (March to April)

- **Weather:** Temperatures soar past 35°C to 40°C.
- **Highlights:** April brings the famous Songkran Water Festival featuring massive citywide water fights.
- **Downside:** Agricultural burning creates heavy smoke and poor air quality from late February through April.[](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/best-time-to-visit-chiang-mai) 

Rainy or Green Season (May to October)

- **Weather:** Warm and humid with frequent afternoon downpours.
- **Highlights:** Landscapes are lush and green, waterfalls flow strongly, and flights and accommodations offer deep budget discounts with fewer tourists.
- **Downside:** Heavy rains can occasionally disrupt outdoor plans or muddy mountain trails.[](https://www.lonelyplanet.com/articles/best-time-to-visit-chiang-mai)
